item.title: A message from the main office:
item.description: A reminder that tomorrow is a pre-paid Ravens' wear day. If you have not made the online payment and come to school in Spirit wear, you must bring $2.00 to the office

item.title: A message from Ms. Clune:
item.description: Gr. 7/8 Cross Country Runners will meet in the Atrium right after Homeroom attendance. Be sure to bring your Ravens jersey, shoes, warm layers, water, and lunch. We will be leaving at 8:15.

item.title: A message from Mr. Cornellier and Mr. Letendre.
item.description: The first junior and senior girls' volleyball tryout will be held this Friday after school. A sign up sheet is posted in the gym foyer. There is no volleyball session on Wednesday of this week.

item.title: A Message From: Mme Perron.
item.description: There will be a very quick Europe Team Meeting today at the beginning of lunch for approximately 10 minutes. ALL TRAVELERS MUST ATTEND!!!
